item.text: I’m shifting to the domestic-safety record: repression of protests, censorship, political imprisonment, and the state’s handling of wartime fear inside Russia. I’ll gather a mix of official, UN, NGO, and Russian-language reporting, then trim to the clearest non-duplicative claims.
